bio: Malcress is a 21-year-old self-taught illustrator studying graphic design in Czech Republic. She loves painting animals, creatures, and landscapes, whether they already exist or are yet to be imagined and created in a fantasy or horror setting. Her style is very painterly and atmospheric, full of colors, various textures, and glitches. Her dream is to design and illustrate creatures and landscapes for video games or individual clients.
title: Malcress
